Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, we're almost there. What's the first thing you're going to do at camp, Buford?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Find a nerd, take his underpants, and run 'em up the flagpole.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't think Camp Phineas and Ferb has a flagpole.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Then I guess I'll just find a nerd and take his underpants.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You may have my underpants. They just got very messy all of a sudden.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Thanks, but it ain't the same if Buford don't rip 'em off of you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What about you, Isabella?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: The Fireside Girls and I are going to work on our accomplishment patches.

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: Yay! Accomplishment patches!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How about you, sis? What's the first thing you're gonna do at camp?

Name: Candace
Dialog: First of all, it's not camp. It's just Grandma and Grandpa's cabin, and it's boring.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But we made T-shirts.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Secondly, I don't like the outdoors, okay? I don't like bugs. Phineas, are you even listening to me?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I seem to have misplaced my ant farm.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yes, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sighs) Do I have to go to Grandma and Grandpa's?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, I think it's rather sweet that Betty Jo and Grandpa Clyde invite you kids and all your friends every year.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But I'm not a kid. I'm a young adult. Can I do something with you guys?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Of course you can, Dear. You can join us at the antiques symposium. This year's keynote address will debate Shellac vs. Lacquer.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Woo-hoo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to Phineas) I'll take one of those shirts. (Sobs)

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Where are they?

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Look. Oh, here they come now. (Clyde laughs)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hiya, Grandpa!

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Well, hello Phineas! You haven't changed a bit!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Grandpa, that's not me! That's Perry!

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Huh? Huh? Oh, oh, right. Looks like I need to get my glasses fixed!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Laughs) With the glasses.

Name: Clyde
Dialog: And Turbo Ferb-o! Put 'er there, put 'er there, put 'er there, put 'er there, put 'er there, put 'er there! (Laughs) Still a man of few words, I see.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, actually I--

Name: Clyde
Dialog: So, where's your sister?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hello? Hello! What do you have to do to find a cell signal in this place?

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, hi Grandma. How can you stand living out here in the middle of nowhere?

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Oh, come on, honey. It's not so bad. You'll see.

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Alright, nature lovers! Time for vittles!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Laughs) "Vittles" is "Grandpa-ese" for "food". Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry about that, Agent P. We haven't used that tree slide in years. Not since I was at... the Academy. (Sad music) Anyway, Doofenshmirtz seems to be up to something, Agent P. He's hold up at his evil woodland retreat. Your mission is to find out what he's up to. Please, Agent P. Be careful. (Thinking) The Academy.

Name: Kid
Dialog: But I don't want to go to the Academy, Daddy.

Name: Man
Dialog: I'm not your father, and it's been decided.

Name: Kid
Dialog: I love you, Daddy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, you pesky bugs! I am trying to tan here!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace. I thought I'd bring my favorite camp counselor a Phineas special.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That is just a glass of limeade. And I am not a counselor.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas. The girls have finished pitching the tents. (The Fireside Girls salute in front of their tents) Can you sign here for our Tent Pitching achievement patches please?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure thing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are you doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, as camp director, I'd say I'm "Doing my job".

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Gather around, kids. There's an old legend, well, not that I believe it, about the Sasquatch. A race of giant, hairy creatures living up here in these very woods. (Kids gasp) If my memory serves, I think there was a song written about it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Really? Do you remember any of it?

Name: '(Song
Dialog: "He's Bigfoot")

Name: Phineas
Dialog: He remembers.

Name: Kids
Dialog: (Cheer)

Name: Clyde
Dialog: One more time!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! Am I the only adult here? Why can't my grandpa act his own age?

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: I think you should act your age. And have a little fun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sorry, Grandma.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: There's all sorts of fun a young adult can have here. You've just gotta use your imagination. So come on! We're making stick figures! Out of real sticks!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Grandma!

Name: Grandma Betty Jo
Dialog: All right, all right, all right. We'll think of something else.

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: Oh, uh, hello. I'm looking for Strudelcutie4427. (Notices Perry, picks him up) Wow, aren't you the cutest little thing? Are you my date for this evening?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no! (Laughs) Uh, that would be me. I'm Strudelcutie4427. Nice to meet you. Uh, this is my pet platypus. He was just going outside for a nightly walk.

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: Oh, could I hold him a little longer? He's so sweet. (At Perry) Oh, yes. Yes you are.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughs) Well, I guess he can stay a- A little bit, but- You know what they say. Three's a crowd and whatnot. (Laughs)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Gulp) Ahh. Just how I like 'em.' You've just earned your marshmallow patch, my friend. (Candace sighs) So, Grandpa, what should we do now? Tell scary stories? I got one!

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Oh, Phineas, you always start. Why not give another kid a chance?

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Yes. How about you, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No.

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Okay. Anyone else? Uh, Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: W-what? Uh, uh, oh. Thank you. (Flashlight switch flips; Wolf howls) Well, this is a story about a kid who comes to this country, and goes to camp. He, like, has to share a tent with a bully. It's really quite terrifying, actually. Quite terrifying. (Crickets chirp; Flashlight switch flips)

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Take it away, Phineas.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, Grandpa. I've got a good one. It's about Bigfoot!

Name: Dimitri/Pedro/Ginger
Dialog: Bigfoot?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Bigfoot?

Name: Squirrel
Dialog: Bigfoot?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Grandma!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Sorry, dear.

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: You are the cutest thing I've ever seen. Yes, you are. Yes, you are.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, some people say we look alike.

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: Uh, I don't think so. (At Perry) Not at all. No, not at all.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, darling, you haven't even touched your cucumber water. I made it especially for you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: You know, Strudelcutie4427 was a lot less needy online.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Sighs) I'm going to go get some air.

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: ...Lot less needy online. (Door squeaks)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Sips cucumber water, Spits it out) Oh, I don't even like cucumbers! Why do I always get the crazies?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And they say that when the moon is full, like it is tonight, Bigfoot will return, and exact his revenge. (Leaves rustling) Huh? What was that noise?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I really should have packed more underpants... (The kids continue to scream endlessly in fear and terror.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (He hears their hollers; Gasps) That sounded like screaming children! But it's not my birthday. (He falls off the balcony screaming)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You guys crack me up! (Laughing)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, what are you talking about?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There's no Bigfoot! It's just Ferb in the tree! Look! See? They're just dummies! (At Ferb) Nice rope skills, my friend!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Then... who is this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ah, it's an inflatable Ferb. (Air hissing) Sounds like Ferb too.

Name: Buford
Dialog: That was awesome!

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: What was that? You better stay here while I investigate. (She goes outside, allowing Perry to escape) Oh! (sees the leaf-covered Doofenshmirtz) Bigfoot?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh? What?

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: Bigfoot!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, no! Wait! It's me! Ugh! (The date hits him with her purse, causing him to fall)

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: Strudelcutie4427? Whoops.

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Whoa! That was a good one, boys. You sure got us.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't take it anymore!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It was just a joke, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You're a joke, Phineas!

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Candace, Honey, calm down!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Calm down? Calm down?! I don't wanna calm down!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Your screaming might attract a real Bigfoot.

Name: Candace
Dialog: A real Bigfoot? Oh, give it a rest, Phineas! Everyone knows there's no such thing as a real- (sees Bigfoot behind her. The monster roars.) Oh, fine. What's this one made of? Popsicle sticks and glitter?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, no.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh. GAAAAAH! (Bigfoot grabs her and eats her; making the kids run away)

Name: Clyde
Dialog: (Laughs) Looks like we fooled 'em, ma! (Laughs)

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: (Laughs) Did you see the look on their face? (Laughs)

Name: Candace
Dialog: That was so cool!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Oh, good one!

Name: Candace
Dialog: And you got an inflatable Grandma, too.

Name: Grandma Betty Jo #2
Dialog: Oh, I'm not inflatable. I'm your Grandma's identical twin. I only come out once a year when these two want to prank someone. Well, back to my closet.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: See you next year, Lorraine. (At Candace) Oh, come on. Let's round up those scared kids and have some hot cocoa.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (falls down and lands on the ground) It's not the worst date I've ever had. There was that one that kept stabbing me with a fork. Get this off of-- (sees the Bigfoot dummies and runs for it)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Laughs) I sure got you guys! You should have seen your faces! Only unsophisticated, immature brains would believe in monsters. (Laughs) Yes, it takes a mature adult, such as myself, to know that there's... no such... thing... as... (Stammering) Bigfoot! (she screams and runs inside; the other kids look but see nothing)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, I do not believe her one bit. Too much overacting.

Name: Kids
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I smell ham.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Perry. Why are you all covered in lipstick?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: One more time!
